name: Heartbeat
description: Wakes the master every few minutes to look at the situation, without any chat history: it sees only the home right now and its open plans. When something matters it opens a new chat just for that (a reply is about that one thing); otherwise it stays silent.

quiet_end.title: Quiet until
quiet_end.help: No heartbeat in between (the same time twice = never quiet).

tools.title: Allow tools
tools.help: Slower; it already gets a snapshot of the home, and small models tend to tour every room with tools.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.placeholder: Look through the states. If anything needs the user's attention now - an alarm (smoke, gas, water leak, CO), a door or window OPEN that should not be, a device that failed, a task due now - tell them in one short sentence. Normal states (lights, closed doors, weather, time, values in normal ranges) are not worth mentioning: then answer exactly NOTHING.
instructions.help: Empty = the built-in instructions (shown greyed out), so improvements to them reach you.
